files.policies.yml:
# Synthetic example household (A9). Base currency OMR.
version: 1
base_currency: OMR
accounts: [salary, savings, broker, cash]
categories:
  income: [salary, bonus, side]
  expense: [housing, food, transport, family, discretionary, fees]
  transfer: [transfer]
  invest: [buy, sell, dividend]
snapshot_max_age_days: 45
policies:
  - id: WLT-01
    type: cap
    title: discretionary spending per month
    measure: {sum: expense.discretionary, period: month}
    limit: {pct_of: income, value: 10}
  - id: WLT-02
    type: floor
    title: emergency fund
    measure: {holdings: class.cash}
    limit: {months_of: expense, value: 6}
  - id: WLT-03
    type: routine
    title: monthly transfer to savings
    match: {tags: transfer, account: savings, min_amount: 300}
    period: month
  - id: WLT-04
    type: red_line
    title: no margin, no options
    match: {tags_any: [margin, options]}
  - id: WLT-05
    type: kill
    title: broker pilot drawdown
    measure: {drawdown: account.broker, window_days: 90}
    limit: {pct: 15}
  - id: WLT-06
    type: allocation
    title: equities band
    measure: {share: class.equity}
    band: {min_pct: 2, max_pct: 30}
  - id: WLT-07
    type: cap
    title: total expense per quarter
    measure: {sum: expense, period: quarter}
    limit: {value: 2400}
  - id: WLT-08
    type: routine
    title: rent paid every month
    match: {category: housing, min_amount: 250}
    period: month

# Synthetic example household (A9). One decision per entry; A3 watches review_by.
- id: D-2024-10-01
  date: 2024-10-01
  title: start broker pilot with 500 OMR
  policy: WLT-05
  criteria: "stop if drawdown > 15% in any 90 days; review quarterly"
  review_by: 2025-10-01
  status: closed
  closes: null
- id: D-2025-12-05
  date: 2025-12-05
  title: broker pilot stopped after the November drawdown; no new money, position kept
  policy: WLT-05
  criteria: "the kill fired on 2025-11-30 (drawdown over 15%); this decision answers it"
  review_by: 2026-03-01
  status: closed
  closes: WLT-05
- id: D-2026-01-10
  date: 2026-01-10
  title: keep the monthly savings transfer at 300 OMR through 2026
  policy: WLT-03
  criteria: "raise to 350 if side income exceeds 1000 over the year"
  review_by: 2026-12-31
  status: open
  closes: null
- id: D-2026-06-01
  date: 2026-06-01
  title: review the family support amount before the school year
  policy: null
  criteria: "decide by mid-September whether 100 OMR per month still fits"
  review_by: 2026-09-15
  status: open
  closes: null
